Reviewed PR #60 for HHH-21130 and addressed one concrete coverage gap.

The two-line production correction is appropriate: each complete filter fragment is grouped before it is combined with sibling filters or query/join restrictions. Parameter marker offsets still index the original fragment; alias handling and binding order are unchanged. Default filter alias injection passes through Template rendering, which converts Boolean literals through the actual dialect. An H2-only restriction is therefore not justified by the fixture's true/false literals.

The original 10-case suite meaningfully covers the entity restriction, fetched collection owner isolation, parameter-free OR, multiple enabled filters and parenthesized/non-OR compatibility. Lazy collection cases are baseline-passing controls, not claimed defect reproductions.

Review traced a concrete mutation caller: enabled filters in TableBasedUpdateHandler flow through AbstractEntityPersister and FilterHelper to the same filter predicate visitor. This triggered the linked issue's conditional mutation-coverage requirement. Added one small public-API bulk UPDATE regression, guarded at method level with the existing SupportsDmlTargetColumnQualifier convention. It requires one affected row and then reloads unfiltered in a fresh transaction to verify the other owner's row remains unchanged. No additional production change was warranted.

Committed the 18-line test addition as 6f534fb454af8a85488075073f069a048f1fc163, parent ee7f4cf236895bdff2599ab5ca3321235de2fb64. No CI-skip directive is present.
